title: CostCraft: Delta-evaluator and Safe-Apply Orchestrator for Batch/Cache Tuning
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: automated batch/cache recommendations can materially reduce token cost but sometimes cause subtle quality regressions (semantic drift, hallucination rate, formatting glitches). We need an evaluator + orchestrator that ties any automatic cost-driven config change to a robust acceptance test and a safe apply/rollback choreography.

Goal: Build the CostCraft Delta-evaluator and Safe-Apply Orchestrator to (1) score candidate batch/cache config changes against quality gates before applying, (2) run an automated shadow-and-canary rollout when applying approved changes, and (3) trigger deterministic rollback on regression signals.

Overview of the solution:
- Local name: CostCraft. Core components: Delta Evaluator (DE), Acceptance Corpus (AC), Canary Orchestrator (CO), and Rewind Engine (RE).
- Delta Evaluator computes a multi-dimensional delta for a candidate config relative to a baseline: numeric metrics include token-cost reduction percentage, latency P50/P95 change, semantic-similarity delta (embedding cosine), output-structure fidelity (schema pass rate), and human-annotated anchor pass rate. DE emits a weighted "delta-fidelity" score.
- Acceptance Corpus: stratified set of prompts derived from: production traffic stratified by route/intent, long-tail sample, and a curated anchor set of ~500 signature prompts covering critical behaviors (billing language, legal disclaimers, multi-turn state, code snippets). Anchor prompts are immutable and used for deterministic regression checks.
- Statistical gates: non-inferiority test on anchor pass-rate with alpha=0.01 and margin=1.5% absolute; semantic-similarity delta must be >= -0.03 (cosine units); structural/schema pass-rate must not drop by >0.5%. A candidate config must pass all gates OR be flagged for human review.
- Canary policy: apply in shadow mode (no user-visible change) for 2 hours to capture telemetry, then 5% canary for 6 hours with live traffic routing and full trace capture, then progressive ramping (25% 12h, 50% 24h, 100%) only if no gate breaches. Any gate breach at any stage triggers immediate automatic rollback to the last good config.
- Rollback triggers: (a) anchor pass-rate drop beyond margin, (b) semantic-similarity drop beyond threshold, (c) spike in customer-facing error-rate or formatter failures, (d) latency SLO breach > 20% increase at P95.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Delta Evaluator outputs a deterministic score and a per-metric breakdown for every candidate config within 15s for a standard candidate set.
2) The system can run the acceptance corpus in shadow mode on a dedicated autoscaled runner and produce a pass/fail decision with logs and diff artifacts.
3) Canary Orchestrator integrates with routing policies and executes progressive rollout and automatic rollback with no loss of routing consistency.
4) Post-apply dashboard surfaced in Console with token-cost delta, latency delta, per-route regression flags, and link to artifacts.
5) All failing cases create an actionable incident with reproduction steps and attach replay of requests and outputs.

Implementation plan:
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): prototype DE that runs the acceptance corpus offline using existing eval harness and embedding service. Provide JSON report schema.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): implement acceptance gates + CLI to evaluate candidate configs and produce human-readable report. Wire into CI for manual approval.
- Phase 3 (4 weeks): Canary Orchestrator + Rewind Engine integration with routing layer and runtime. Add automatic rollback & audit logging.
- Phase 4 (2 weeks): instrument Console dashboard and alerting + run internal dogfooding across two customer routes.

Metrics to monitor:
- False negative rate on regression detection (target < 3% on annotated samples).
- Time-to-detect regression in canary (target < 15m).
- Cost reduction realized vs predicted.
- Number of automatic rollbacks and root causes.

Security & compliance: config artifacts and evaluation outputs must be encrypted at rest; audit logs forwarded to central audit collector; consider masking PII in replays. Security review required for Rewind Engine storage of request payloads.

Rollout & mitigation: start with low-risk customer routes (logging, embeddings) and exclude high-SLA critical customers until mature. Provide a manual "pause" toggle in Console to block any automated apply on a tenant.

Longer term: integrate with Cost Tuner to propose candidate configs automatically and attach a predicted delta-fidelity score before enqueueing to CostCraft for evaluation.
